text:
maria.s: heads up — acmehealth tenant (org: acmehealth-9f4a) reports console shows NO models. API /v1/models returns 403. login/billing ok. escalating to security.
support-bot: ticket #12345 created and linked. escalation: security + oncall.
sam.w: on it. can you paste org_id and a sample request id?
maria.s: org: acmehealth-9f4a, req-id: req_0ab3c. console empty models pane. audit shows 'role_mapper: applied new policy set' at 2025-03-12T13:21:48Z
deploy-bot: role-mapper v2 deployed 2025-03-12T13:21:48Z -> migration started
kai_ops: quick look at the debug logs — the attribute 'can_list_models' was moved under svc_policy during the refactor but the permission-check path still reads legacy_roles. attr lookup mismatch.
eng-security-bot: automated check flagged 1 tenant with role-attr mismatch after role-mapper v2 deployment.
sam.w: ok. quick mitigation: temporary override binding (org:admins -> role:model_viewer) for acmehealth-9f4a. need ops approval to apply.
maria.s: :thumbsup: please apply, customer needs access back ASAP.
kai_ops: applied override binding at 2025-03-12T13:40:12Z (grant model_viewer to acmehealth-9f4a). verifying.
maria.s: customer confirms models list back in console. API /v1/models now 200 with model ids. trying to deploy a model now but hitting KMS decrypt errors.
sam.w: logs show kms decrypt fail: "kms:Decrypt failed: access denied" for key projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/tenants/9f4a/cryptoKeys/tenant-9f4a-key. suspect KMS key policy didn't get migrated during tenant migration.
kai_ops: I'll add tenant service account to the key IAM policy and clear key cache.
deploy-bot: kms-sync job queued for tenant 9f4a at 2025-03-12T13:55:02Z
kai_ops: updated KMS IAM binding and restarted key cache. decrypt calls now succeed from our side.
maria.s: customer verified deployment succeeded and receives inference traffic. recommending follow-ups: full role-attr reconciliation for all tenants, add a migration preflight check and a smoke test for model-list+kms on role-mapper rollouts.
sam.w: creating ENG ticket with action items (migration safe-check, runbook update, automated smoke test). tagging eng-ml + infra.
maria.s: customer satisfied. will close support ticket after 24h monitoring. thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
